command: MIXDOG_RECORDER_SCRATCH=<scratch parent> node benchmarks/rust-core/recorders/record-sensitive-writes.mjs --tree <export of b6f10295a2f698afc85332467192de28500bd146 with the patches applied> --patch benchmarks/rust-core/recorders/node-patches/node-fix-sensitive-side-writes.patch,benchmarks/rust-core/recorders/node-patches/node-fix-sensitive-header-summary.patch,benchmarks/rust-core/recorders/node-patches/node-fix-sensitive-memory-scrub.patch

noCoreCounterpart.mixdog_data_dir/history/agent-trace.json: the agent trace: the core writes none (a known gap)
noCoreCounterpart.mixdog_data_dir/prompt-cache-idle-gaps.j: the prompt cache's idle-gap statistics: the core keeps none

normalised: lib/sensitive-writes-files.mjs: the session id as <session>, the workspace as <ws>, the profile folder as <profile>, every other run-specific id (uuid, prefixed random id) as <id:N> by first appearance in file order, every ISO time as <iso> and every epoch time in milliseconds as <ms>, file names with the same substitutions; a binary file (SQLite, WAL) is listed by name and size only and searched for the values

notCompared.mixdog_data_dir/gateway-usage.local.json: usage telemetry, no session content: Node buffers its rows and flushes them on a timer (route-meta.mjs recordGatewayUsageEvent), so a phase's process that exits first loses them; this recording keeps only the last turn's row
notCompared.sends[].messages (role system/developer): the replay compares each model call's conversation (role, text, tool-call arguments) and not its system/developer instructions, which the scenario never puts a value in; the instruction text is outside this set's question

product.tree: product tree loaded by the recorder
